description: This file contains unit tests for the AttributeModified class, which is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It tests immutability, equality/hashcode, creation with null parameters, JSON serialization/deserialization, and captures references to specific constants and object creation related to AttributeModified events.

classes.name: AttributeModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AttributeModified, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that AttributeModified instances are immutable, along with JsonPointer and JsonValue classes.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to check correctness of equals and hashCode implementations in AttributeModified.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeModified with null String ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeModified with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAttributeKey
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeModified with null attribute key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson() method produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an AttributeModified instance from JSON and verifies its fields.
